session: LIDAR-04 (branch arena/6c75ae04-gemsdoe66, 2026-10-20; originally labelled LIDAR-03, renamed at merge)
lane: Native-resolution lidar scarp channels: slope-aware scarplet template (Sare & Hilley JOSS 2018 doi:10.21105/joss.01066; AGU 2015 T31A-2838) + Steger (IEEE TPAMI 20(2):113-125, 1998) + Frangi (MICCAI 1998 LNCS 1496:130-137) on slope-detrended local-SNR surface; aggregate channels = scarp-pixel fraction, local-contrast SNR amplitude, crest/toe pairing, unsigned polarity dominance. Operators at 100-400 m on 2 m-descriptor aggregates — native 2-20 m execution NOT measured (raw USGS 3DEP 1 m tiles unreachable from sandbox).
hypothesis: Subtle off-catalogue scarps are locally anomalous (high step/ex relative to ~1 km background roughness), spatially distributed within the cell (scarp fraction), and show paired convex-crest/concave-toe curvature with one dominant facing; the signed antislope preference used by LIDAR-01/02 is an anti-signal (AUC 0.3014 reproduced) whose removal plus local-SNR deconfounding yields DTI gain not confined to range fronts.
mechanism: rank01( (0.25*snr + 0.20*persist_snr + 0.15*frac + 0.15*pair + 0.10*pdom + 0.10*frangi_rank + 0.05*steger_offset_rank) * (0.5+0.5*sqrt(step_rank*ex_rank)) ); snr = 0.5*rank(step/bg_step) + 0.5*rank(ex/bg_ex), bg = gaussian sigma=5 cells; greedy emission identical to LIDAR-02: K=37654, >=3 px separation, >2 px (200 m) from catalogue, relief-tercile allocation by eligible-footprint share (truth-free). Field is the only changed variable vs LIDAR-02.
named_nonfault_mimic: Fluvial terrace risers / irrigation canal banks (locally anomalous, single-polarity, paired-curvature steps). No pinned cultural-feature mask exists in this checkout; pairing+persistence demote but do not eliminate them.
